in_sanskrit.name: श्रीकान्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: Wealthy, prosperous, and possessed of the Goddess of Fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) - Wealthy, prosperous, abundant कान्त (Kant) - Possessed of, belonging to, God of desire (Kama Deva) or Goddess of Fortune (Lakshmi)

in_hindi.name: श्रीकान्त
in_hindi.meaning: श्री (Shri) - वेदिक शक्ति, धन, सुख, प्रसाद (Wealth, prosperity, power, grace, blessings) कान्त (Kant) - कामदेव के साथियों से संगत, या लक्ष्मी के साथिय (Belonging to, associated with, God of desire Kama Deva or Goddess of Fortune Lakshmi)

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீகாந்த
in_tamil.meaning: ஶ்ரீ (Shri) - ஆனந்தும் வெள்ளியால், வெளியிட்டும் வளர்ந்தும் (Wealth, prosperity, power, grace) காந்த (Kant) - காமம் அல்லது லக்ஷ்மியிட்டு இடம் களிய (Belonging to, associated with, God of desire Kamadeva or Goddess of Fortune Lakshmi)

in_telugu.name: శ్రీకాంట
in_telugu.meaning: శ్రీ (Shri) - దేశియోద్యే, దేశియోద్యేశ్వరయోద్యే, శుభదేశయోద్యే (Wealth, prosperity, power, grace, blessings) కాంట (Kant) - కామదేశయోద్యేయ సహోదరయోద్యే, లక్ష్మీయోద్యేయ సహోదరయోద్యే (Belonging to, associated with, God of desire Kamadeva or Goddess of Fortune Lakshmi)

in_marathi.name: Srikant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Srikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the Lord of all wealth, including material and spiritual wealth.

in_bengali.name: Srikant
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Srikant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the Lord of all wealth, including material and spiritual wealth.
